title: Workflow field update silently lost when several records are saved at the same moment
sub: TAVI CRM crm.taviportal.com, Education First tenant (Ebhar Misr) · intermittent: 1 of 5 parallel batches so far · Zoho side not applicable

noShot.Zoho: Not comparable. A rule logged as "Fired" whose field update is silently not applied is a reliability defect whatever Zoho does. (Whether Zoho lets a workflow rule update the blueprint field at all was not checked.)

Application stays at Registration Approved with a link saved; no assessor is assigned; nobody is alerted

notes: Request to the developers: check the server logs for EM-00075 / 76 / 77 / 79 / 81 around 15:36:40 UTC on 21 Oct. Likely a row-version / lock conflict on the governed field that is swallowed.
Expected: the update is applied reliably (retry on conflict), or the execution is logged as failed with the error — never reported as Fired when part of it did not run.
The rule's own hint says the Field Update 'updates fields on the current record before it's saved' — relevant to how concurrent saves are merged.
